surfaces.name: Dialog
surfaces.reason: React preserves ReactNode title/description/footer composition, portalContainer, initialFocusRef, autofocus interception callbacks, trapped focus, scroll locking, and restoration. The canonical dialog rebuilds its owned Light DOM and does not expose the complete React portal/focus/composition contract.
surfaces.exitCriteria: Add a shared modal-overlay adoption contract for rich composition, portal targeting, initial focus, autofocus interception, focus containment/restoration, and dismissal without narrowing React props.

surfaces.name: Drawer
surfaces.reason: Drawer shares the React modal overlay runtime and rich composition/portal/focus contract while the canonical renderer owns and reconstructs its modal Light DOM.
surfaces.exitCriteria: Use the same shared modal-overlay adoption contract required by Dialog while preserving Drawer placement and size behavior.

surfaces.name: Popover
surfaces.reason: React clones an arbitrary trigger, preserves its handlers, owns controlled/default open state, portal targeting, anchored placement/offset/trigger-width matching, dismissable layering, and optional modal focus behavior. Canonicalization cannot currently adopt that React trigger/content ownership without changing behavior.
surfaces.exitCriteria: Add framework-neutral trigger adoption plus anchored overlay placement, portal, dismissal, and focus contracts that preserve the existing React composition API.

surfaces.name: Tooltip
surfaces.reason: React owns arbitrary trigger handler composition, delayed pointer/focus activation, aria-describedby merging, Escape dismissal, portal targeting, and anchored positioning. The canonical tooltip owns its trigger/content model and cannot preserve the full React trigger event contract yet.
surfaces.exitCriteria: Add canonical trigger adoption and timing/ARIA/portal/anchored-position contracts with equivalent event-handler composition.

surfaces.name: Toast
surfaces.reason: React Toast accepts ReactNode title, description, and action content plus hover/focus pause-resume callbacks and renders VyrnForge Icon/IconButton composition. The canonical toast rebuilds string-oriented title/description/actionLabel DOM.
surfaces.exitCriteria: Add rich toast content/action adoption and pause-resume lifecycle contracts before replacing the React renderer. ToastProvider, ToastAction, and useToast remain covered by their existing S14 framework exceptions.

surfaces.name: ConfirmDialog
surfaces.reason: React ConfirmDialog composes the React Dialog plus canonical-backed Button controls and preserves ReactNode title/description, loading cancellation rules, and controller callbacks. Migrating it before the modal overlay contract would transitively narrow Dialog behavior.
surfaces.exitCriteria: Migrate after the shared Dialog/modal overlay adoption contract can preserve React rich composition, focus, portal, dismissal, loading, and action callback semantics.
